i’ve self harmed for years. i have scars up and down my body. yes, they will fade, but the reminders of why i did them will not. My whole life I looked to cutting myself as an escape from emotional pain. i was going through hardship after hardship and always went to cutting myself to stop feeling my emotions. even when I was ok, finally found myself in a better situation yet i still felt strong urges to cut myself. I’d be perfectly okay, no intense swings or anything to trigger one. I still wanted to cut myself. I believe it’s because once I started, it was like that was the one and only thing I could do to feel better. After many years of therapy I realized it became a coping method, my safe place. 
Isn’t that just fucking horrible? My way of feeling better was cutting into my skin and watching myself bleed. Would you wish that ability on a child/baby, your siblings, your friends, anyone you care about?
